outcome: Obstetric outcomes (miscarriage, placenta previa, preterm delivery)
cohort: A 31-year-old nulliparous woman with a history of fibroid-enlarged uterus who underwent two UAE treatments.
finding: This case demonstrates that successful conception and childbirth are possible after two uterine artery embolization procedures for symptomatic fibroids when patients undergo close follow-up and individualized management.
mod_finding: The first successful delivery after UAE was by cesarean section.
followup_time: The patient was followed from age 31 (first UAE) through her second delivery after a second UAE at age 35.
